column3: Invoke the FastAPI/Starlette app object passed to install(), running its internal middleware without a socket; external ASGI wrappers and lifespan work are outside the probe. Listener-added headers and TLS are unobservable. Apply BootUI's 8 KiB body, decoded body and header-retention limits; connect timeout and redirect handling are inapplicable to direct ASGI calls.

Apply BootUI's 2-second timeout per request to cooperative async work; synchronous event-loop blocking delays timeout delivery, while an AnyIO threadpool handler may continue after timeout and single-flight release. The elapsed scan time is not a hard bound.
Send BootUI's literal loopback Host; a host TrustedHost rejection is incomplete evidence rather than a scan of its 400 error page.
Do not expose raw body, exception text, or unsafe response header values; retain only bounded sanitized evidence to preserve sharpit's masking boundary.

A non-404 response without a positive disclosure marker leaves a no-finding conclusion indeterminate with the status recorded; positive stack or cause markers still produce PT-A05-006, and 3xx responses follow BootUI's rule-specific checks.

Run the in-process ASGI probe on the host loop; acquire SingleFlight.try_acquire and release in finally after cancellation. A timed-out AnyIO threadpool callable may still run after release, so another scan can begin while it finishes.

MCP and CLI worker threads wait at most 5 seconds for the host-loop coroutine (two BootUI request budgets plus margin); timeout returns 504 without cancelling the coroutine, whose flight remains held until the loop releases it.

The Python adapter evaluates the bounded HTTP response checks of the security-header and error-disclosure families on the GET probe and the TRACE advertisement on the OPTIONS probe. Spring Security, servlet configuration, JVM serialization, and Actuator metadata have no Python source equivalent and remain explicit coverage limitations.

The OPTIONS-derived CORS checks (PT-A05-007, PT-A05-008, PT-A05-023, PT-A05-065) and the CORS expose-headers check on both probes (PT-A05-073) are not evaluated yet; they belong to lane A11 and the report states them as pending.

The GET-derived cookie and session checks (PT-A02-001, PT-A02-002, PT-A02-003, PT-A02-007, PT-A02-008, PT-A05-005, PT-A05-064) are not evaluated yet; they belong to lane A12 and the report states them as pending.

PT-A05-006 uses BootUI's JVM stack-frame and qualified-exception patterns plus the Python traceback header; a body under HTTP 400 without a stack frame or a cause line is not reported. The finding names no marker text. A truncated body is evaluated on its retained text and the truncation is a separate limitation.
A response without a Content-Type is classified by its body, as in BootUI; BootUI's Spring whitelabel 404 exclusion has no Python equivalent and is not applied.
Finding titles, severities and remediation texts are BootUI's, including Spring-specific wording; header and body values are named, never echoed.
